name: __main
comment: Keil ARMCC entry: set SP, __scatterload, branch to main

name: read_u32_le
comment: load 4 bytes little-endian from unaligned pointer

name: write_u32_le
comment: store 4 bytes little-endian to unaligned pointer

name: __scatterload
comment: walks Region$$Table at 0x2000F468: RW decompress to 0x04000000, ZI 0x04000604..0x04004A40

name: __decompress1
comment: Keil RW-data LZ decompressor (ported in tools/keil_scatter.py)

name: delay_ms
comment: busy wait n ms, feeds watchdog each ms

name: periodic_tasks
comment: flag-driven task runner (flags @0x04000D65); bit1 -> razer_cmd_dispatch() and friends

name: razer_cmd_dispatch
comment: verify CRC, dispatch on command_class, recompute CRC, set status

name: razer_cmd_class00_device
comment: class 0x00: version (0x87), serial (0x82), device mode (0x04 -> bootloader), factory reset (0x0B)...

name: razer_cmd_class06_storage
comment: class 0x06: on-board storage / profile and macro memory

name: button_action_execute
comment: executes the action bound to a physical button (mouse button, key, DPI step +-100 up to 26000, profile, ...)

name: settings_mark_dirty
comment: schedules persistence of a settings group to flash

name: g_razer_report
comment: Razer 90-byte HID feature report buffer (shared by SET/GET_REPORT)

name: SystemCoreClock
comment: core clock in Hz (12 MHz reset value, 96 MHz after clock_init)

name: g_bootloader_magic
comment: 0xAAAAAAAA written here then NVIC_SystemReset() => stay in bootloader (PID 0x110E)

name: usb_device_descriptor
comment: USB device descriptor: VID 0x1532 PID 0x0099 bcdDevice 0x0200
